body: OK what is actually happening here? `$class`/`$className` isn't used, so I wonder how the class is being generated
The real code uses `eval()` here, with lots of things behind there. I stripped all that out for a simple reproducer.
Right, I thought it might - anyhow, this is now fixed (in 62dacaf): https://psalm.dev/r/4735271151
@Ocramius but you need to fix your parameter name: docblock specifies type for `$className`, but function signature uses `$class`.
@muglug Shouldn't Psalm complain about `ChildType` inheriting `ParentType`, but not providing a way to fill in the parent type parameter?

> @Ocramius but you need to fix your parameter name: docblock specifies type for `$className`, but function signature uses `$class`.

Indeed, did the usual mess while creating the example ^_^'
I've just tried 62dacaf locally and still get an issue that is very similar to this: trying to somehow isolate it.
Reported #1677 based on findings after this fix. Fix seems to work, but sorting issues in intersection types are likely still hidden/existing.
